End-to-end ingest-to-price must complete within four hundred milliseconds or
the market suspends. This leaf is a DRAFT: the budget came out of one interview
and no moderator has checked it against the pipeline's own measurements, which
is why the resolver downranks it and preflight verdicts it unknown.
